events.title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 5 released
events.summary: Samsung began selling the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 5 — gapless hinge design and lighter chassis.
events.about: Foldables forced Android developers to handle resizable and multi-window layouts on flexible displays. Gapless hinge design and lighter chassis.

narrative.whyChosen: The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 5 pushed foldable Android hardware into the mainstream.
narrative.whyImportant: Foldable form factors require adaptive UI patterns beyond fixed phone screens.
narrative.problemSolved: Phones were locked to a single rigid screen size and aspect ratio.
